hints.title: Preorder Parenthesized Serialization
hints.text: Construct a string with parentheses representing left and right child relationships in preorder.

hints.title: Empty Left Parentheses Invariant
hints.text: If a node has a right child but no left child, empty parentheses () must be preserved for the left child to maintain binary tree distinction.

hints.title: Four Case Recursive String Formatting
hints.text: If node is null, return empty string. If node is leaf, return value. If node has only left child, return val(left). If node has right child, return val(left)(right), where left is empty string if left child is absent.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Preorder traversal with four structural omission rules.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Omission of empty left parentheses creates ambiguous deserialization.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct string concatenation formats preorder syntax in linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Preserve empty parentheses only when the right child exists.
